title: Mixed-universe internal Hom exchange before applying global sections
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y'\to Y$ be morphisms of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ and projections $g_X:X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Write $H_Z(P,Q)=R\mathcal Hom_{\mathcal O_Z}(P,Q)$ [def-pur-derived-internal-hom], $F=Rf_*$, $F'=Rf'_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image], $L=Lg^*$, $L_X=Lg_X^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and $\beta:LF\to F'L_X$ for the canonical base-change map [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]. Let $c_h:R h_*H_T(P,Q)\to H_S(Rh_*P,Rh_*Q)$ be the pinned evaluation-mate direct-image comparison of [lem-sc-mixed-hom-direct-image-comparison]. Define $p_h:Lh^*H_S(P,Q)\to H_T(Lh^*P,Lh^*Q)$ by transposing $\tau_h^{-1};Lh^*(\operatorname{ev}_{P,Q})$, using the pinned tensor comparison [def-pc-derived-pullback-tensor-comparison] and tensor-Hom bijection [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection]. For all $M,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], the following identity holds in $D(\mathcal O_{Y'})$: $$\beta_{H_X(M,N)};F'(p_{g_X}(M,N));c_{f'}(L_XM,L_XN);H_{Y'}(\beta_M,1)=L(c_f(M,N));p_g(FM,FN);H_{Y'}(1,\beta_N).$$ Neither base-change component is assumed invertible. This assertion concerns internal Hom, not derived global sections. This uses only the sheaf localization universe, and the tensorator is the normalized mixed tensorator [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso].

proof.text: Construct the direct-image tensor pairing q by transposing the tensor of adjunction counits. Tensor-Hom naturality and the defining mate equation for c show that the transpose of c is q followed by direct image of evaluation. Counit and tensorator naturality also prove naturality of q. These are the proved private helpers directImage_evaluation and tensorPairing_naturality.

Apply injectivity of the tensor-Hom equivalence on Y′. Naturality in the first and second Hom variables transposes the two displayed paths. Expand p by Equiv.apply_symm_apply, so its evaluation is precisely inverse tensorator followed by pulled-back evaluation. Naturality of q moves the upper pullback comparison inside direct image; naturality of the g tensorator moves the lower direct-image comparison inside pullback.
Apply mixedTensorPairing_baseChange to A = RHom_X(M,N), B = M, C = N and the evaluation morphism a. This identifies exactly the two remaining composites.

theorem mixedInternalHom_baseChange_exchange
    {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (M N : schemeDerivedCategory X) :
  let p := fun {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S) (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory S) ↦
    ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv T)
      ((derivedPullback h).obj
        ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology S) S.sheaf).obj (op P, Q)))
      ((derivedPullback h).obj P) ((derivedPullback h).obj Q)).symm
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso h).inv.app
          ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology S) S.sheaf).obj (op P, Q), P) ≫
          (derivedPullback h).map
            ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv S)
              ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology S) S.sheaf).obj (op P, Q))
              P Q (𝟙 _)))
  let H := fun Z : Scheme.{u} ↦ derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Z) Z.sheaf
  let c := fun {S T : Scheme.{u}} (h : T ⟶ S) ↦
    mixedHomDirectImageComparison h
  schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g (pullback.fst f g)
      pullback.condition ((H X).obj (op M, N)) ≫
    (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).map (p (pullback.fst f g) M N) ≫
    (c (pullback.snd f g)).app
      (op ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M),
        (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N) ≫
    (H Y').map
      (X := (op ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
        ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj M)),
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)))
      (Y := (op ((derivedPullback g).obj ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M)),
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f g)).obj
          ((derivedPullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj N)))
      ((schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
        (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition M).op, 𝟙 _) =
    (derivedPullback g).map ((c f).app (op M, N)) ≫
      p g ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj M) ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj N) ≫
      (H Y').map
        ((𝟙 _).op, schemeDerivedBaseChangeMap f (pullback.snd f g) g
          (pullback.fst f g) pullback.condition N)
